svg.title: Models of solutions
svg.desc: Equal-volume solution models P and Q show separated ions. P is labelled 0.30 M NaCl and Q is labelled CaCl₂. Water molecules are omitted. Model P contains six Na⁺ ions and six Cl⁻ ions. Model Q contains four Ca²⁺ ions and eight Cl⁻ ions. The equal-size boxes represent the same small volume of solution. Each ion is separate; no water molecules, water orientations, or calculated concentrations are shown.
